controls: native run-action captured outcome survives outer witness failure and committed retry refuses before launch
adapter run-check captured execution/receipt survives outer witness failure with one adapter call
limits: Attestation history and semantic paths exercise canonical command/service APIs, not all transport combinations.
An outer external-operation witness fault intentionally retains previously committed intent/outcome transactions; it does not roll those back.
run-check assertion covers no automatic duplicate call, not exactly-once deliberate checker retry.
